sections.title: Sound of letter D
paragraphs: The letter name is (D) /diː/. Its main sound is heard in (dog) /dɒɡ/, which means a friendly animal. This letter makes three spoken sounds in English, and it can also be silent.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue tip. Release the air suddenly with voice. Touch your throat to feel the buzz. For the second sound, release the air without voice. For the third sound, touch behind that ridge and release with friction. For the silent sound, make no movement at all.

sections.title: Reading letter D
paragraphs: In most places, say /d/ as in (dog) /dɒɡ/. After an unvoiced consonant, say /t/ as in (hoped) /həʊpt/. Before the letter u, it often sounds like /dʒ/ as in (educate) /ɛ.dʒʊ.keɪt/. It is a silent letter in (Wednesday) /wɛnz.deɪ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not touch your teeth with your tongue tip. Keep your tongue on the ridge behind your teeth, not against the teeth. Do not blow a strong puff of air at the end of words like (bed) /bɛd/. Release the air softly and keep your vocal cords buzzing.
